column1: # The goh subcommands that run one house script, one per line (GOH.LANDUNION): NAME[|ALIAS...] TAB
# SCRIPT (from the goh root) TAB the line `goh --help` prints. Adding one is this one line: no
# shared line of cli.rs or main.rs, and .gitattributes merges the table by row (lib/row_merge.py).
# The script takes every argument, `--help` included (GOH.SHIPADOPT). Order is the help order.

column3: Each live subagent idle past a threshold on its own background work; exit 1 if any stalls
Land a green HEAD unwatched: push gate, release, install, verify, done (`tools/ship.py`)
The commit gate's verdict on these paths before the commit (`tools/lint.py`)
Enqueue, wait on or drain the landing queue, or `--report` its wall time (`tools/landq.py`)
Every subject's time budget: ARMED, BREACHED or CLEARED, last and median runs (`lib/budget.py`)
Where a land's minutes and cpu-s go, stage by stage, by mode and load: `--normal-since ISO` (`lib/land_profile.py`)
The machine's room for another write lane: slots, load, memory, disk (`lib/capacity.py`)
The cache root to use now: the removable tier when mounted, marked and roomy, else internal, with the reason
Rank every build cache once (GDSF) and demote or delete to the budget (plan|run|hold)
Point the sccache server at the cache root the resolver chooses now (check|apply|start)
Name estate repos with stale stock hooks; `--refresh` fixes them (`hooks_refresh.py`)
Name estate workflows pinning an older goh release; `--bump` moves them (`wf_pin.py`)
Rank what burns the CPU by process family and repo from the sampler's ledger: `--report [--since]` (`lib/load_sources.py`)
Block until a pid is gone, a file is there, JSON holds values, a land or a ship finished (`lib/proc_wait.py`)
Stop processes YOU started, by pid or stamp, TERM then KILL; refuses any other (`lib/proc_stop.py`)
Put back only your own edits in your own worktree, keeping a copy for `--back` (`tools/undo.py`)
The header lines and Agent call a subagent spawn needs, from the active model-choice profile (`hooks/claude/brief.py`)
The flake register: every test that went red and passed on a retry, by test (`lib/flakes.py`)
Retire the files of a store that moved into goh.db: `retire [STORE...] [--dry-run]` (imported, read back equal, archived, deleted) or `stray` (`lib/state_retire.py`)
The ship rows a test left in goh.db (a result under a temp root), listed; `--delete` removes them (`lib/ship_test_rows.py`)
Every red land record's cause class by count, with example records: `--last N`, `--json`, `--backfill` (`lib/land_reds.py`)
Run a Linux-safe test shard in the worker container on another host, local fallback with the reason (`tools/remote_shard.py`)
What each script does, rendered from the files' own headers: every one, or `map NAME` (`lib/map_table.py`)
